<translate>
The '''Big Gete Star''' is a huge, half-buried mechanical sphere on [[Special:MyLanguage/Namek|Namek]]. Its inner chamber is the lair of the [[Special:MyLanguage/World Bosses|world boss]] [[Special:MyLanguage/Metal Cooler Core|Metal Cooler Core]], and its robots march on the Namekian villages.
</translate>

<translate>
== The star ==
</translate>
<translate>
* Its hull is '''unbreakable'''.
* The drained ground around it hides some '''[[Special:MyLanguage/Gete Tech|Gete Debris]]''', a rare ore.
* Around the star, up to 2 '''Metal Cooler patrols''' (a Metal Cooler scout with 2–3 [[Special:MyLanguage/Gete Robot|Gete Robots]]) roam near players. Gete Robots also march from here on the [[Special:MyLanguage/Namekian Village|Namekian villages]].
* In worlds created before the star was added, it still appears: because it's too big to place at once, it's filled in gradually (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Structures#Existing worlds|Existing worlds]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== Metal Cooler Core ==
</translate>
{{Main|Metal Cooler Core}}
<translate>
The [[Special:MyLanguage/Metal Cooler Core|Metal Cooler Core]] waits in the star's inner chamber, and only wakes for players inside that chamber. See [[Special:MyLanguage/World Bosses|World Bosses]] for how lairs, waking and respawning work.
</translate>

<translate>
== Finding it ==
</translate>
<translate>
The Big Gete Star generates once per world, in the Ajissa Plains or the Sacred Land, at least 1,000 blocks from the world origin. Every [[Special:MyLanguage/Namekian Trader|Namekian Trader]] sells a '''Big Gete Star Map''' for 16 Emeralds (4 uses). Players with the locate permission can use {{Command|/dmzlocate gete_star}} on Namek.
</translate>
